name: Call of Earth

angles.text: As a shaman, heeding the call of earth begins your path, binding you to deep stone and the steadfast spirits of the land.
As a dwarf, your bond with stone and earth can make communion with these spirits feel natural in Dun Morogh’s deep vaults.
As an Alliance shaman in Dun Morogh, you begin your elemental journey at Anvilmar, the ancestral dwarven stronghold.

faq.answer: The Call of Earth summons an aspiring shaman to begin communion with the earth spirits. It directs the initiate to seek guidance and find grounding in the power of living stone.
Teo Hammerstorm teaches initiates inside Anvilmar, the dwarven stronghold in Coldridge Valley. He guides them in communing with the earth and learning its steady strength.
Anvilmar is a dwarven holdfast in Coldridge Valley, in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. Forged by hammer, fire, and will, it is a redoubt where young heroes train.
A shaman heeds the call of earth to ground their spirit and find firm footing beneath their soles. Communion with stone brings its steady power within reach.
faq.q: Why must a shaman heed the call of earth?

faq.answer: The summons is for shamans beginning their path in Dun Morogh. It directs them to experienced elemental trainers who can guide their bond with the spirits.

aliases: where does call of earth take place
faq.answer: The journey leads to Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, within snowy Dun Morogh. Initiates go inside the holdfast to find their mentor.

sections.body: An initiate’s first communion with the elements begins when the earth calls. Other elemental energies may already stir, but speaking with stone brings balance. The earth teaches the initiate to find strength that will not yield. Firm footing comes beneath their boots and within their spirit.
sections.title: The Voice of Stone

sections.body: In Dun Morogh’s snowy reaches, initiates find shelter and instruction at Anvilmar. The holdfast lies in Coldridge Valley, forged by hammer, fire, and will. Teo Hammerstorm waits within, teaching fledgling shamans to heed the rumbling earth and begin their elemental duties.
sections.title: The Holdfast of Anvilmar

summary: In Coldridge Valley, the Call of Earth sends an initiate to seek Teo Hammerstorm at Anvilmar. There begins a shaman’s communion with the spirits of stone.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Earth
